name: Iron Desert: Fire Storm
summary:
Your goal: to dominate the enemy in epic battles. Your arsenal: cutting-edge, super-powerful weapons. Iron Desert will keep you on the edge of your seat from the very first second! Gather valuable resources, develop your base, upgrade your arsenal, and forge a legendary army. Confront the fearsome Steel Dragon and his most loyal right-hand man, Commander Scarface, and liberate the continent from their yoke!

You'll begin your military career in command of a simple military encampment, which you must transform into an impregnable fortress. But the best defense is a good offense! Fight other players and reduce their bases to ashes. Form a clan with your friends to crush all who dare stand in your way and establish your rule across the desert.
